scope: Previously unlinked >=60-point candidate_review_pool Source IDs. An ID can refer to more than one actual event and one event can have multiple IDs. This material is evidentiary, not a new native decision round.

cases.body_reference: RWE May 27 issuer release; 50 MW / 400 MWh full-operation test, 144 Megapacks separately confirmed in RWE 2025 release
cases.bounded_evidence: September recap describes already-operating Limondale grid BESS; commissioning/full-operation milestone predates the collector window.
cases.must_not_claim: new September commissioning or 144 new assets separate from the 50MW/400MWh plant
cases.remaining_native_gate: Record source support against existing Full card and resolve formal per-ID 0.1P exclusion/related decision.

cases.body_reference: Issuer body: existing operational sites, six additional hubs future Q1 2027, Voltloader access and preferential terms
cases.bounded_evidence: New commercial charging-access partnership with Voltloader; existing Markham Vale site not a new opening, six future sites not commissioned at signing.
cases.must_not_claim: six sites already operational or distinct new 39-bay Markham Vale project
cases.remaining_native_gate: Evaluate significance of preferential-rate network agreement versus prior operational site; verify original event date.

cases.primary_source_owner: R3 Lithium / Business Wire issuer release
cases.body_reference: Issuer release; USD15m Series A and initiated operations; continuous carbonate production targeted 2027
cases.bounded_evidence: Same issuer announcement already recorded in the locked Full card. Initiation of operations is not demonstrated 2027-scale mass production.
cases.must_not_claim: full commercial steady-state production already achieved
cases.remaining_native_gate: Native per-ID duplicate resolution and source-lineage receipt.

cases.primary_source_owner: Idaho Copper / issuer GlobeNewswire and SEC filing
cases.body_reference: September 22 issuer release reproduced as SEC Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1; USFS allows exploration drilling, not mine development
cases.bounded_evidence: US Forest Service drilling-plan clearance for CuMo copper/molybdenum exploration; project development and commercial mining unapproved.
cases.must_not_claim: mining permit, FID, new operating copper supply or battery-material delivery
cases.remaining_native_gate: Assess Stage A structural importance versus exploratory material status.

cases.body_reference: Planted September 15 issuer release: $31.8m Series B; future robotic solar deployment scaling
cases.bounded_evidence: USD31.8m growth financing announced for automated solar installation and software; no new completed solar capacity quantified.
cases.must_not_claim: USD31.8m as signed installation revenue or finished MW
cases.remaining_native_gate: Assess solar-construction applicability to battery/ESS decision scope.

cases.body_reference: Government release: three distinct sites, each 50MW/200MWh
cases.bounded_evidence: Three-site inauguration with total 150MW/600MWh is already represented by the Full card carrying the exact same government URL.
cases.must_not_claim: six sites or three new independent cards for a single three-project inauguration
cases.remaining_native_gate: Native source-to-asset identity mapping; keep all three site identities distinct inside one milestone.

cases.body_reference: Issuer 8-year marketing/offtake announcement, estimated ~10k tonnes per year, initial supply projected 2028
cases.bounded_evidence: Offtake/marketing agreement links future recovered lithium output to Hartree; $500m+ expected trade value is an estimate, not irrevocable guaranteed revenue.
cases.must_not_claim: 2026 shipment, guaranteed $500m purchase, or claimed BIS black-mass export ban without independent original BIS verification
cases.remaining_native_gate: Inspect definitive contractual terms, volume enforceability, and independently verify/reject BIS export-control premise in issuer commentary.

cases.body_reference: MSIM 1GT lead investor release: EUR49m Series E, Amber energy-automation expansion plans
cases.bounded_evidence: Funding closed/announced; Europe expansion intention is not a completed EU customer deployment.
cases.must_not_claim: European rollout completed or issuer estimated market share independently audited
cases.remaining_native_gate: Assess technical battery-dispatch novelty, geographic rollout stage and card independence.

cases.primary_source_owner: Republic of Korea official government briefing
cases.body_reference: Government summit outcomes: Export-Import Bank of Korea and Bancomext $100m on-lending MOU and sector scope
cases.bounded_evidence: New USD100m proposed on-lending cooperation limit; memorandum and facility framework, not proof funds were disbursed to firms.
cases.must_not_claim: USD100m already loaned to EV/battery manufacturer or a battery-only credit line
cases.remaining_native_gate: Verify signed MOU exact limit/closing status and assess supply-chain finance relevance.

cases.body_reference: Issuer September 23: signed EPC, Estonia 192MW/420MWh with 330kV substation; future Nov2027 operation
cases.bounded_evidence: Signed implementation contract for named Raudsepa BESS project, with LG Energy Solution battery supply noted, planned construction and future commercial operation.
cases.must_not_claim: BESS commissioned in September 2026 or proven 2027 dispatch
cases.remaining_native_gate: Check signed contract counterparty, procurement certainty, assets, date, and source diversity.

cases.primary_source_owner: Rainbow Rare Earths / issuer exchange announcement
cases.body_reference: Issuer RNS: nonbinding MOU for proposed rare-earth separation and offtake; indicative 40% NdPr / 65% SEG+ terms
cases.bounded_evidence: MOU outlines further study and a contemplated processing/offtake pathway, not signed long-form binding commercial commitments.
cases.must_not_claim: binding 40%/65% delivered volumes or existing operational pilot plant
cases.remaining_native_gate: Original RNS annex and MOU enforceability plus independent public impact.

cases.body_reference: September 23 bookbuild RNS: at least US$36m (£26.9m); September 24 after retail offer: US$40.2m gross aggregate as issuer final announcement, subject to admission/settlement
cases.bounded_evidence: Subscription and institutional bookbuild successfully completed with subsequent retail offer, raising total announced gross proceeds to US$40.2m; separate from August land-access deal.
cases.must_not_claim: US$30m as final proceeds, Sep23 US$36m as final all-in proceeds, project FID already taken, or admission/settlement already completed Sept24
cases.remaining_native_gate: Reconcile September 28 AIM admission and cash receipt versus announced gross fundraising before formal score.

cases.primary_source_owner: Export-Import Bank of the United States
cases.body_reference: EXIM release: up to US$7bn mobilization through 2027, critical minerals and energy-grid prioritized sectors
cases.bounded_evidence: Two governments signed an investment/export-finance cooperation framework, not a US$7bn approved transaction list.
cases.must_not_claim: US$7bn credit disbursed or committed to named mines
cases.remaining_native_gate: Verify legal funding authority and actual loan approval distinction for governance classification.

cases.body_reference: September 24 issuer release: filed preliminary F-4; merger and US$77.5m PIPE first announced July 27
cases.bounded_evidence: F-4 filing is a distinct disclosure milestone but not an effective registration or closed transaction. Two collector IDs are the exact same secondary URL.
cases.must_not_claim: merger/PIPE closed, planned Gotion 20GWh factory operating, two independent filing milestones
cases.remaining_native_gate: Read SEC F-4 exact enterprise-shareholding and audited financials; determine material increment versus July terms.

cases.body_reference: Issuer release 315kW power plus EMS; January 2026 59-charger plaza was a different earlier event
cases.bounded_evidence: Papendal site deployed and operating a 315kW behind-the-meter battery and energy management; two collector IDs link same source URL.
cases.must_not_claim: 315kWh storage energy capacity from 315kW power or 315MW grid BESS
cases.remaining_native_gate: Confirm battery MWh duration and systematic significance before standalone vs WATCH.

cases.primary_source_owner: Ningbo Sanxing Medical Electric / SSE issuer filing
cases.body_reference: 2-page filing: US$132m = CNY885m US datacenter project oil-immersed transformer contract; 6.16% FY25 revenue
cases.bounded_evidence: Signed oil-immersed transformer order for US data-center and storage electrical infrastructure.
cases.must_not_claim: US$132m battery pack or ESS cell shipment; '储能油变' is transformer equipment
cases.remaining_native_gate: Evaluate industry relevancy outside direct battery packs and confirm trading-country/export risk.

cases.body_reference: Investor release: equity investment CLOSED; amount undisclosed, US/Canada charging expansion future
cases.bounded_evidence: Equity investment has closed, with amount not published; additional charging sites are an intended use of funds.
cases.must_not_claim: invent a disclosed investment amount or installed new charging MW
cases.remaining_native_gate: Assess capital size transparency and standalone structural value.

cases.body_reference: September 2: DP World Canada 46 satellites 4.4MW first phase, FRAME with no binding order volumes; September 14: separate GCT port site operating 21 dual-plug satellites / 42 ports / 2.05MW
cases.bounded_evidence: One Electrek article joins a framework agreement with DP World and an already installed GCT charging project, involving different port operators; retain two event identities under one source ID.
cases.must_not_claim: GCT and DP World are same counterparty, 46+21 satellites all contracted under one binding order, or both projects opened on Sep26
cases.remaining_native_gate: Adjudicate DP World framework binding status independently from GCT physical deployment and compare with existing Kempower Full card.

cases.primary_source_owner: Forum Mobility / PR Newswire issuer release
cases.body_reference: Forum issuer: four planned California depots totaling future 30MW, public Tesla Megacharging at 3 sites; existing FM Harbor charged since 2024
cases.bounded_evidence: Four depots planned; Tesla to operate public Megacharging at 3 locations; existing 9MW Harbor separate and not new September opening.
cases.must_not_claim: 30MW commissioned now, Tesla will operate all four depots, or all 330 reserved Tesla trucks already delivered
cases.remaining_native_gate: Check capex/site schedules and whether agreement is binding vs planned capacity.

cases.body_reference: Issuer 3-page earnings release: NPATMI US$54m +830% Y/Y from ~$6m, revenue US$1.048bn +67%, EBITDA US$311m +306%, growth driven mining/processing
cases.bounded_evidence: Verified period-profit rebound plus production mix, not proof new battery-grade nickel output increased 830%.
cases.must_not_claim: 830% increase in battery material shipped, USD54m quarterly net income, or high-pressure acid leach expansion already commissioned
cases.remaining_native_gate: Compare prior Full nickel-sector profit cards, base effects and public-company filings.

cases.body_reference: EVE issuer filing 2026-121: sells 45% Hubei Enjie stake to Shanghai Enjie for CNY1,150m (11.5亿元), post-close no stake
cases.bounded_evidence: Board approved equity transfer and contract signed for CNY1.15bn; completion contingent on implementation, not established merely by signing.
cases.must_not_claim: completed legal title transfer, 11.5bn yuan (10x error), or sale of EVE core cell business
cases.remaining_native_gate: Cross-check Shanghai Enjie's contemporaneous filing and closing conditions, Stage A contract status and Related.

cases.body_reference: Issuer release: approximately KRW160bn (1,600억원), Sep17 2026-Dec31 2028; possible further three-year extension, not automatic
cases.bounded_evidence: L&F and SK On executed an LFP cathode supply agreement, distinct supplier from separate POSCO Future M–SK On contract.
cases.must_not_claim: POSCO Future M and L&F are same counterparty, three-year contract extension already exercised, or future Seosan/US output already shipped
cases.remaining_native_gate: Confirm DART/KRX definitive disclosure, minimal purchase guarantee and separate Related/overlap.
